overview: The Council approved a request to discontinue using asphalt for repairs in concrete sidewalk areas and sought the administration's COVID-19 vaccination distribution plan. The meeting also included approvals of committee reports on zoning, tax rates, and several city ordinances.

items.title: Asphalt Sidewalk Replacement Discontinuance
items.summary: Approved a request for the Department of Public Works to discontinue using asphalt panels to replace concrete sidewalks to maintain aesthetic standards.

items.title: COVID-19 Mitigation and Enforcement Update
items.summary: Tabled an update on COVID-19 mitigation and safety enforcement for one week.

items.title: Tabled Resolutions
items.summary: Tabled resolutions 20-676 and 20-679 for one week.

items.title: COVID-19 Vaccination Distribution Plan
items.summary: Requested the city administration provide its COVID-19 vaccination distribution plan, including priority sites and distribution schedules.

items.title: Ordinance Updates Committee Report
items.summary: Approved reports from the Committee of the Whole regarding draft ordinances for collection bins, behavioral health, and rodent control.

items.title: Tax Rate Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a committee report concerning the establishment of the upcoming fiscal year's tax rate.

items.title: Zoning Update Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a committee report regarding the ongoing zoning code update and the expected delivery of a draft consultant report.

items.title: Commendations and Recognitions
items.summary: Approved commendations for Brian Branson’s decades of youth sports volunteerism and John Giglio’s retirement after 50 years owning VIP Barbershop. The Branson resolution was referred to the Athletic Director and Hormel Commission for naming dedication consideration.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the minutes from the December 8 meeting.
